questions.question: What makes a shape a polygon? Use a circle and a triangle to explain.
questions.expected_answer: A polygon is a closed 2D shape with only straight sides. A triangle is closed and has 3 straight sides, so it is a polygon. A circle has a curved outline and no straight sides, so it is not a polygon.

questions.question: A shape has 6 straight sides, but they are not all the same length. Name it and say whether it is regular or irregular.
questions.expected_answer: It is a hexagon because it has 6 straight sides. It is irregular, because a regular polygon must have all sides equal and all angles equal.

questions.question: Is a square turned to stand on its corner still a square? Explain.
questions.expected_answer: Yes. Turning a shape does not change its sides or angles. It still has 4 equal sides and 4 square corners, so it is still a square.
